capabilities: Transcribe audio files using a Whisper-compatible STT API
Summarize transcripts with an OpenAI-compatible LLM
Write generated notes into daily notes
Process audio in batches by date range or from selected files
Customize summarization via a configurable system prompt
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin store; manual installation from GitHub is described. The README documents that audio and transcripts are sent to user-configured external API endpoints and that API keys are stored locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn audio recordings into structured, summarized daily notes automatically.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible STT and LLM service (e.g. OpenAI, Groq, DeepSeek)

summary: AI transcription plugin that sends audio recordings to a speech-to-text API and writes LLM-summarized notes into daily notes.
